evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 3.04 -> 3.33 Torr from t=2520 to 3240 with Ar flow steady at 100 sccm
O2 sensor not installed, so atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified as the growth stage requires
Temperature holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~46%, no thermal anomaly

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or leak-check/pump-down test with Ar off) to distinguish a seal leak/air ingress from partial exhaust blockage as the cause of the rising pressure
